# ARRAY_AGG over INTERVAL values ordered by themselves before other keys
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/aggregate_functions#array_agg
#
# BigQuery rejects ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i) over INTERVAL values with "Unsupported type INTERVAL
# for array_agg.", and runs ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY n, i) and ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY j). These ask
# whether it rejects them ordered by themselves first, and descending.

# An INTERVAL value ordered by itself, then by an INT64 key.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i, n))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (0, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
?>

# An INTERVAL value ordered by itself descending.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i DESC))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 40 DAY, INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 2 HOUR]) AS i
?>
